Choose homogeneous algebra generators f_i of weights beta_i. The finitely many inequalities <eta,beta_i> >0 define a nonempty rational open cone containing the prescribed Reeb. The actual Y=Proj R_eta_e is integral projective of dimension p. A sufficiently divisible d gives an actual invertible ample L_d=O_Y(d). Generator powers of degree d give a standard graded subalgebra over which R is finite, since each generator satisfies its monic power equation; the degree-d powers trivialize O(d) on the covering Proj charts. This is the original quotient and bundle, not a resolution or numerical replacement.

On a homogeneous localization R_f, normality persists. An element of Frac((R_f)_0) integral over (R_f)_0 is integral over R_f, hence belongs to R_f; it is invariant under the grading action and therefore lies in its degree-zero summand. All original Proj charts are normal. At EVERY point the local ring is a normal domain, its reduction and integral closure are itself, and the residue extension is the identity. Thus it is geometrically unibranch, exactly as in the literal definition and proof on https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BPZ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BQ3. The original field and its cardinality are unchanged. Established EP therefore applies to this Y and this actual L_d. The normal reduced variety over perfect k is also geometrically reduced, verifying the scope of the general relative-volume estimate used in projective target continuity.

Retain the residual torus and canonical reference. Twist the natural T-linearization by a degree-d eigencharacter gamma; on mL_d the residual weights become alpha-m gamma. Eigenunit transitions in degree-zero charts give the actual continuous torification q with q^2=q. Let B=q(Y^an), a compact closed carrier, and ell:B->K be the calibrated homeomorphism. The components globally generate, since their simultaneous vanishing would imply simultaneous vanishing of the original system. The Gauss maximum is chi o q and dominates chi by the ultrametric inequality. Uniform approximation extends this to CPSH. A genuine decreasing CPSH defining net composed with q decreases to chi o q at EVERY analytic point, including minus infinity. The fixed trivial valuation retains its finite value, excluding an identically minus-infinity limit. Energy monotonicity gives E_Ld(chi o q)>=E_Ld(chi), so actual E1 torifies to actual invariant E1.

For cone u, lift a raw decreasing CPSH defining net by chi=sd u o ell o q. Its pointwise limit is actual projective PSH. Conversely, torify a defining projective CPSH net of an invariant actual chi and lift it to cone CPSH. The equivariant extensions decrease at every punctured-cone point, including minus infinity; the finite trivial value gives actual membership. The formulas are inverse. The projective probability divides raw curvature by (L_d^p), not by V_eta.

For an actual E1 tuple, simultaneous raw decreasing CPSH approximation and ACTUAL fixed-eta mixed and weighted decreasing continuity extend the calibrated identity ell_*m_Ld=MA_eta. The weighted identity is int_K u_0 MA_eta=(sd)^(-1) int_B chi_0 m_Ld. Every E1 test is integrable. In the energy-pairing proof the integral is the TEST-containing pairing MINUS the zero-test pairing, at each finite stage and at the limit. Closed B and K retain support, and mass remains one. Apply it also to max(chi_i,chi), which has bounded J and converges divisorially; the corrected identity |a-b|=2(max(a,b)-b)-(a-b) proves absolute L1. BJ9.20 is likewise independent of EP. For a xi-CPSH psi put g_t=R_xi,eta(psi+t). Global actual order gives S_psi(Ru)<=t iff S_g_t(u)<=0, including unbounded values. A positive constant shift c changes roots between c/b and c/a; the inverse ratios are 1/b,1/a. Hence the equivalence also holds for strict negative gaps, and complements give strict superlevels. Roots and their inverses are therefore tau-homeomorphisms. Compactness transfers to xi.

Conversely assume every actual E1 potential is integrable. For normalized u set b_l=-int u MA_xi(u^[l],rho^[p-l]), l=0,...,p. The integrals int(-u)dmu are bounded by a constant C on normalized J<=1. Otherwise choose u_j in that class with integrals >=2^j. The midpoint Green kernel is one half min(t,1-t). On [1/4,3/4] its value is >=1/8, every monomial is >=4^(-(p-1)), every binomial is >=1, and the interval length is 1/2.
